item.title: At a pharmacy abroad
item.context_text: You are on holiday in Dublin. You have a cold: your throat hurts and your nose is running. You go into a small pharmacy near your hotel.
item.objective_text: Read the sign, understand the pharmacist, and ask for something for your cold.
item.target_grammar: I have a… / Do you have something for…?
item.cultural_note: In many countries the person in a pharmacy can give advice about small problems like a cold. It is normal to say what is wrong and ask, "What do you recommend?"
success_conditions: Find the opening times and the pharmacist's desk
Understand how often to take the medicine
Say what is wrong and ask for help politely

children.title: Read the pharmacy sign
children.instructions: Read the sign in the window. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
CITY PHARMACY
Open: Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm
Sunday: closed
Questions about medicine? Please ask at the pharmacist's desk at the back of the shop.
We also sell water, tissues and snacks.

questions.prompt: Where can you ask about medicine?
options: At the desk at the back
questions.explanation: "Please ask at the pharmacist's desk at the back of the shop."

children.title: Listen to the pharmacist
children.instructions: The pharmacist gives you some tablets. Listen. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: OK, so these tablets are for your sore throat. Take one tablet twice a day, in the morning and in the evening. Take them after food, not before. And drink a lot of water and hot tea. If you feel worse in three days, please see a doctor. That's five euros, please.

questions.prompt: How often do you take the tablets?
questions.explanation: "Take one tablet twice a day, in the morning and in the evening."

children.title: Ask for help
children.instructions: Speak to the pharmacist. Say what is wrong (two problems) and ask for something for your cold.
children.prompt_text: Pharmacist: Hello! How can I help you?
children.goal: Say what is wrong and ask for medicine politely.
children.model_answer: Hello. I have a cold. My throat hurts and my nose is running. Do you have something for a sore throat, please?
